findings.passage: Pennsylvanians deserve to show up to their polling place trusting in the election process.
findings.note: Text on the Election Reform page of his official site, which says elections need reform focused on accountability, security and training, and that he is committed to making the system better. The page names no ID rule. The page is undated.

findings.note: Release issued by his office listing priorities for the session, including that elections be conducted fairly and accurately. This is the release's own sentence, not a quotation of him, and it names no ID rule.
